shortDescription: Exports the ASM policy from remote nodes.

options.name: base64
options.description: If C(true), the returned C(inline) ASM policy content is Base64 encoded. Only applies to C(inline) ASM policy exports.

options.name: binary
options.description: If C(true), the exported ASM policy is in binary format. Only applies to C(file) ASM policy exports.

options.name: compact
options.description: If C(true), only the ASM policy custom settings is exported. Only applies to XML type ASM policy exports.

options.name: dest
options.description: A directory to save the policy file into. This option is ignored when C(inline) is set to C(true).

options.name: file
options.description: The name of the file to be created on the remote device for downloading. When C(binary) is set to C(false) the ASM policy is in XML format.

options.name: force
options.description: If C(false), the file will only be transferred if it does not exist in the the destination.

options.name: inline
options.description: If C(true), the ASM policy is exported C(inline) as a string instead of a file. The policy can be be retrieved in the playbook C(result) dictionary under the C(inline_policy) key.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the policy exported to create a file on the remote device for downloading.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition which contains the ASM policy to export.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.
